questions.question: How do you define your character?

options.text: I am who I am and I don't need to change
I am mostly good, with some flaws
I try to be compassionate and do the right thing
I want to align my actions with my values

questions.question: When you learn something uncomfortable about yourself, you:

options.text: Ignore it and continue as before
Feel conflicted and unsure what to do
Following social norms and fitting in
Being a good person in my own way
Living in alignment with my deepest values
